DAGENHAM UPDATES — MVP SCREENS
Borough Broadsheet, built out. Four screens plus the mobile homepage, in the PRD's build order.
Three of them respond to clicks: the feed filters, the tip form switches type and submits, the mobile menu opens. Try them.
Content is sample copy for layout. Hard facts are left as [DATE] / [SOURCE] / [ATTRIBUTION] for you to fill.

HOMEPAGE — DESKTOP
Every section from your wireframe in order. Two additions worth your eye: the 'How we source' box in the right rail, and the non-affiliation line in the footer. The accent colour is a control above this artboard — try the alternatives before settling on red.

HOMEPAGE — MOBILE
Your tighter mobile order. Breaking sits ABOVE the hero — on a phone the update is the reason someone opened the page.
Tap the menu icon.

ARTICLE PAGE
Carries the trust work: a 'Developing' label, published AND updated times, a timestamped Sources & updates log so corrections are visible rather than silent, and a correction prompt. Share row, related travel, follow CTA in the rail. Click Copy link.

LATEST UPDATES — FILTERABLE
Click the category chips; the list and the count actually filter. Unconfirmed items carry a label inline. Filter to Alerts to see the empty state, which turns a dead end into a prompt to send something in.

SUBMIT A TIP
Pick a submission type — the hint and the subject placeholder change with it. Tick 'send anonymously' and the name/email fields disappear rather than sitting there greyed out. Send it over shows the confirmation state.
The rail does the trust and safety work from section 13: what happens next, what not to send, and emergencies go to the emergency services.

A — BOROUGH BROADSHEET · CHOSEN
Editorial serif on warm paper, thin rules, red reserved for urgent. Signals credible local journalism, which is the PRD's number-one risk.

B — CIVIC MODERN · not taken
Geometric sans, soft cards, navy and amber. Calm and easy to extend, but closest to a stock news theme.

C — STREET SIGNAL · not taken
Condensed caps on near-black with hazard amber. Built for Instagram adjacency; risks reading tabloid.
Worth revisiting for social post templates.
